headline: Claude Code relaunches Projects for coordinating multiple agents
summary: Two outlets report Claude Code relaunching its Projects feature to run several agents together with shared memory and files. One outlet reports that the biggest benefits are cloud-only for now, a limit the other's text does not carry.
